title: Observer’s guide for ISO 2026-W39
planetary_coordinate: geocentric tropical ecliptic longitude; Monday 00:00 UTC

planet_relations.basis: Star Almanack preserved geocentric tropical ecliptic longitude

note:
ISO 2026-W39 runs from September 21 through September 27. Fixed-sky highlights include β Mic, β Ind, α Oct. Uranus is about 4.1° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Naked eye:** 🌕 Full Moon · Harvest Moon — 16:49:02 UTC. Bright moonlight favors prominent stars and planets while reducing contrast on faint deep-sky objects. Use β Mic, β Ind, α Oct as the week’s fixed-sky framework.

**Planets:** Uranus is about 4.1° in ecliptic longitude from Aldebaran in Taurus.

**Binoculars:** Favor β Mic, β Ind, α Oct; wide fields help connect the charted geometry to the real sky.

**Small telescope:** Concentrate on the compact fixed-sky targets selected for the week. Increase magnification only after the target and surrounding pattern are secure.
